name: Kanchi
what: Barbershops, beauty parlours and makeup artists in Bangladesh buy their tools and supplies from a single seller that stocks, checks and delivers everything itself.
hard_part: Built as a clickable two-surface prototype (buyer app and warehouse ops panel) sharing live state through localStorage and BroadcastChannel, so a reorder, pack, courier hand-off and warranty claim can be walked end to end across two tabs before any backend exists.
demo_note: open the buyer app and the warehouse panel from the start page; data stays in your browser
facts: 143 browser checks (93 buyer app, 50 ops) passing locally and against the live site
27 Daraz prices researched for the market study
Bulk tier pricing, two-tap reorder, cash on delivery or bKash
